name: late-run-error-after-finished-run-continues
description: RUN_ERROR after RUN_FINISHED is admitted — a failure that surfaced after the run reported success — the failure is delivered to the application as an event, and everything applied before it is kept
kill: remove the RUN_ERROR exemption from the `runFinished` guard in verifyEvents — the late failure is then rejected with `The run has already finished with 'RUN_FINISHED'`, the run ends failed and no RUN_ERROR reaches the application, so `outcome` and `runError` fail together

stream.message: late-run-error: the transport failed while flushing

expect.runError: late-run-error: the transport failed while flushing
